title: OR: either condition is enough
summary: Use OR inside IF to include Nairobi stores or big sellers in a report, and to flag stores that need support for low sales or low sell-through.

blocks.text: The weekly regional report is long. The regional manager wants every Nairobi store in it, plus any other store with big sales. A second list shows stores that need help: low sales, or low sell-through, or both.
Both rules say "either". The OR function is TRUE when at least one condition is true, and IF turns that into a label.

items: Objective: use OR with IF when one condition is enough.
You pass the mission at 75% or more in the Assessment.

blocks.text: OR returns TRUE when at least one condition is TRUE. It is FALSE only when every condition is FALSE.
Include the store when the region in B2 is Nairobi, or sales in C2 are above the threshold in B9. Text inside a test needs double quotes.

Worked example: a Mombasa store with 620K sales and a threshold of 500K. The region test is FALSE but 620>500 is TRUE, so OR is TRUE and the store is included. A Mombasa store with 400K fails both tests and is skipped.
Tip: AND is strict (all tests must pass) and OR is generous (one test is enough). Read the business rule for the words "and" and "or" before you choose.
Tip: text comparisons ignore upper and lower case, so "nairobi" matches "Nairobi".
Four questions on OR. Type numbers without commas, for example 2.

items: OR is TRUE when at least one condition is TRUE.
AND needs all conditions, OR needs one. Match the word in the business rule.
Text in a test needs double quotes, and case is ignored.
Keep thresholds in input cells and lock them with dollar signs.

blocks.text: Next: NOT, and a clearance rule that combines AND, OR and NOT.

items.prompt: Rule: include a store when the region is Nairobi OR weekly sales are above 500K. Store 1: Nairobi, 300K. Store 2: Mombasa, 520K. Store 3: Kisumu, 500K. Store 4: Nakuru, 100K. How many stores are included?
You want to flag stores that have low sales or low sell-through, or both. Which function belongs inside IF?

options.label: OR, because one low measure is enough
AND, because both measures must be low
NOT, because we are flagging bad stores
SUM, because two measures are added

items.prompt: Which formula correctly shows Include for Nairobi stores or sales above 500K, where region is in B2 and sales in C2?
